scope: Missing-hours research only; do not publish without dated source evidence

records.name: Chong's Szechwan Restaurant
records.notes: Restaurant contact section gives hours at 485 Tyler St. Old Monterey Business Association corroborates the schedule and identifies indoor dining and takeout.

records.name: East Village Cafe
records.notes: The local merchant directory gives a full week at 498 Washington St, corroborated by the claimed Tripadvisor listing. The cafe website could not be reached.

records.name: Kuma Sushi
records.notes: At 414 Alvarado St, the Chamber lists Tue–Thu 4:30–9 PM, Fri–Sat 4:30–9:30 PM and Sun 1–7 PM, while Tripadvisor lists daily 5–10 PM and online ordering posts a separate split schedule. Call the current number in the Old Monterey merchant directory, 831-324-4745, to confirm dine-in hours.

records.name: Mundos Sandwich & Burger House
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Fri 10 AM–5 PM; Sat–Sun 10 AM–4 PM
records.notes: Restaurantji's location listing updated September 23, 2026 matches SuperPages at 170 Webster St. Uber Eats lists delivery hours. The 3 Mundos website represents the separate 2233 N Fremont St storefront.

records.name: Old Monterey Cafe
records.notes: Waze and Roadtrippers agree on the full week for 489 Alvarado St. The cafe previously published the same hours through the Old Monterey Business Association. Its own linked domain was inaccessible.

records.name: Petra Cafe
records.notes: MenuPix and Tripadvisor match for regular hours at 435 Alvarado St. Old Monterey's merchant page confirms seven-day dine-in and separate late-night Fri–Sat takeout. Exact late-night takeout hours remain unconfirmed.

records.name: Taco Bell
records.notes: The latest official location snapshots show 10 AM–11 PM Tue–Thu but expose only one day per snapshot. FindOpen lists Sun–Thu 10 AM–11 PM and Fri–Sat 10 AM–2 AM as general hours, while Waze lists 10 PM closing Sun–Thu. Older chain category pages show midnight on some weekdays. Call to confirm the full dine-in schedule, especially Fri–Sat.

records.name: Terra Superfoods
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Sat 7:30 AM–7 PM; Sun 7:30 AM–6 PM
records.notes: Official homepage publishes hours under its Monterey storefront at 475 Alvarado St.

records.name: Toribashi
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Fri 11:00 AM–2:00 PM and 5:00–8:00 PM (Fri dinner to 8:30 PM); Sat–Sun 11:00 AM–2:30 PM and 5:00–8:30 PM
records.notes: Official website explicitly lists Toribashi at 487 Alvarado St. Separate from Kafe Toribashi at Fisherman's Wharf; holiday exceptions published. Online ordering cutoff may precede closing.

records.name: Turn 12 Bar & Grill
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Fri 11:30 AM–1:00 AM; Sat–Sun 10:00 AM–1:00 AM (closing next day)

records.name: TZone Monterey
records.verifiedHours: Sun–Thu 11 AM–8 PM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–9 PM
records.notes: Restaurantji and Boba Places independently display the same full week for 460 Alvarado St. The Old Monterey merchant directory confirms the location and contact. The Tripadvisor hours are malformed and the linked brand site was inaccessible.

records.name: Taste Cafe & Bistro
records.notes: The restaurant homepage explicitly labels these as current hours for 1199 Forest Ave. RestaurantJump corroborates Sunday closure. The directions page includes Sunday, which conflicts with the homepage. The online order window closes earlier.

records.name: Gelato By The Sea
records.notes: The Cannery Row property directory and Monterey County Now confirm the new branch at 700 Cannery Row, Suite O. No visitor hours were found for this branch. The Carmel schedule and hiring shift hours cannot establish the Cannery Row schedule. Confirm hours directly at this storefront.

records.name: Aquino's Birrieria & Brunch
records.verifiedHours: Regular store hours Tue–Sun 11 AM–8 PM; Mon closed. Call to confirm weekend brunch opening.
records.notes: Official Store tab at 1116A Forest Ave lists 11 AM–8 PM Tue–Sun, corroborated by Roadtrippers. The separate brunch page lists Tue–Fri 11 AM–3 PM and Sat–Sun 9 AM–3 PM, conflicting with the current Store tab on weekend opening. The homepage also advertises brunch all day. Publish regular store hours with a call-ahead note and keep exact brunch times pending.

records.name: Monterey’s Fish House
records.verifiedHours: Lunch daily 11:30 AM–2:00 PM; dinner nightly 5:00–8:30 PM
records.notes: Monterey Peninsula Chamber of Commerce business listing; 2114 Del Monte Ave.

records.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill (Del Monte Center)
records.notes: Official Chipotle location page explicitly lists 500 Del Monte Ctr, Monterey, with daily restaurant hours. Holiday exceptions possible.

records.name: Dametra Fresh Mediterranean
records.notes: The official Visit Us page and homepage both list daily hours for 630 Del Monte Center, corroborating each other. The Chamber listing omits Tue–Thu and differs on Sun–Mon, while the shopping center page leaves merchant hours blank.

records.name: Kona Steak & Seafood
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Thu 4:00–9:00 PM; Fri–Sun 3:00–9:00 PM; Fri–Sat late-night dining until 10:00 PM
records.notes: Official Kona Steak & Seafood website lists regular hours and separate Friday/Saturday late-night dining. 1200 Del Monte Center.
